name: Cá song soup
summary: Canh cá song is one of the three soups Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015, puts in the soup slot of a Hạ Long seafood meal, with canh ngao and riêu hà.
origin: Hạ Long. Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015. Báo Quảng Ninh, 6 May 2020, also lists cá song among the live fish at the market under Núi Bài Thơ.
howToEat: A soup, in the same course as the sour clam soup. A souring ingredient for this bowl was not printed.
A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: The soup course of the ordinary meal. The live fish are at the market under Núi Bài Thơ from 4:30 until before 7:00, on the 6 May 2020 account.
seoTitle: Canh ca song — cá song soup in Ha Long
seoDescription: Canh cá song is one of the three soups in the Hạ Long seafood meal. Live cá song is also at the market under Núi Bài Thơ. A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
